meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,省下输入字数并留一份可读备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次对话都因记忆文件太长而挤占上下文空间。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink memory files to a compact format to cut input tokens, keeping a backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long memory files keep eating your context window.

howto.what: 用 /caveman-compress 指向 CLAUDE.md、待办列表等记忆文件后，Claude 会把其中的自然语言压缩成穴居人式短语以省输入 token，压缩版直接覆盖原文件，可读备份存到树外的数据目录。
howto.when: 当你输入 `/caveman-compress <文件路径>`，或要求压缩某个记忆文件时触发。只处理自然语言文件（.md、.txt、.tex 等），代码类文件不改动。

say.note: 先备份，再用压缩版覆盖原文件

say.text: 把 docs/todo.txt 压成穴居人语
say.note: 可读备份存到树外数据目录
只压自然语言文件，代码文件跳过

howto.what_en: Point /caveman-compress at a memory file like CLAUDE.md or a todo list, and Claude rewrites it in caveman-speak to cut input tokens. The compressed text overwrites the original; a readable backup goes to an out-of-tree data dir.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-compress <filepath>, or when you ask to compress a memory file. Only natural-language files (.md, .txt, .tex, etc.) are handled; code files are left alone.

say_en.note: Backs up first, then overwrites with compressed text
Readable backup goes to the out-of-tree data dir
Only prose files; code files are skipped
